product.title: Beach Hopper Small-Group Snorkeling Tour in Los Cabos

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this small-group Beach Hopper uses a zodiac for half-hour snorkel windows at Chileno Bay and Santa Maria Bay, then continues to Lover's Beach and the Arch of Cabo San Lucas with sea lions on the rocks. A light lunch is included after the swims. The captain adjusts bay order to water conditions rather than a fixed self-guided hop. The format suits visitors who want a guided two-bay snorkel without assembling separate boat tickets. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on Chileno Bay, Santa Maria Bay, Lover's Beach, and the Arch that define this hopper rather than a glass-bottom kayak crossing or a shared sunset sail.
